review_notes: I read the whole file and checked Mathlib's FormalGroup file (Mathlib/RingTheory/FormalGroup/Basic.lean), which defines FormalGroup, IsComm, and Point with Add/Zero/AddCommMonoid. The file's only new definition is `subsetGroup`, an AddCommGroup structure on a subset of V closed under the formal-group sum, with the negative given by (q-1)-fold multiplication. Mathlib's `Point σ` is not the same concept. It is a type of power series with HasSubst, and it has no negation or group structure on elements of a maximal ideal. I found no Mathlib construction of an additive group on a subtype with a custom operation that would replace `subsetGroup`. The theorems `subst_pair_zero_*`, `eval₂_*`, `prod_range_range_eq_prod_prod` and `coe_prod_X_sub_C` are standalone theorem-level overlaps at most, which the rubric excludes. The file imports repo definitions (MvFormalGroup, FormalGroup.eval, evalNSMul, drinfeldDivisorAdic) that I did not review for competing versions, because they are defined elsewhere and not in this file. I did not find a concrete case for consolidation, so I abstain.
